This '''[[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]''' was used as a mount by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Shaak Ti rode the creature during her encounter with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to lead the assassin to the [[Ancient Abyss]]. There, the rancor was ensnared by the tentacles of the Abyss's [[Sarlacc/Legends|megasarlacc]] and swallowed.
